## Highlights

- Check pending weekly and monthly reports at configurable local calendar times in persistent Docker `run` mode. The defaults are 00:15 and 00:30 in `MIKROTIK_REPORT_TIMEZONE`.
- Check both report queues immediately at startup, so completed periods missed during downtime are delivered without shifting future checks. SQLite delivery state continues to prevent resending completed deliveries.
- Keep collection on its independent interval and calculate report deadlines across daylight-saving changes.

## Upgrade notes

Replace `MIKROTIK_WEEKLY_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS` and `MIKROTIK_MONTHLY_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS` in the private environment file with `MIKROTIK_WEEKLY_CHECK_TIME=00:15` and `MIKROTIK_MONTHLY_CHECK_TIME=00:30`, or choose other `HH:MM` times in `MIKROTIK_REPORT_TIMEZONE`. The old interval settings no longer control report checks.

There is no RouterOS, collector, report-output, or SQLite schema change from `v0.1.4`; SQLite `user_version` remains `6`. Stop the running process before updating the code or container image, retain the database, update the private environment file, and restart. Rolling back to `v0.1.4` needs no database restore, but requires restoring the old interval settings if their previous values matter.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Raposo93/mikrotik-report/compare/v0.1.4...v0.1.5
